# Hermes Agent: Getting Started & Troubleshooting FAQ

## 1. Installation & Environment

**Q: Is native Windows or mobile (Termux) supported?**
- **Windows:** Windows 10/11 is fully supported natively using `install.ps1`. Note: the dashboard web TUI terminal requires a POSIX PTY, so WSL2 is recommended if you need the embedded terminal pane.
- **Termux:** Supported on Android. The installer automatically selects the `termux-all` dependency group and uses local `TMPDIR` paths.
- **Docker / ARM64 / NAS:** Multi-arch images (`linux/amd64`, `linux/arm64`) are published for Raspberry Pi and Apple Silicon. For NAS (Synology, UGOS Pro, unRAID) bind-mount permission issues, pass `PUID` and `PGID` (e.g., `PUID=1000 PGID=10`) environment variables.

**Q: Is there a web interface?**
Yes. Run `hermes dashboard` to launch the local web server and open the web dashboard with built-in chat at `http://127.0.0.1:9119`.

---

## 2. Models, Providers & Setup

**Q: Why is Hermes ignoring my local endpoint (`base_url`) or using the wrong provider?**
When `provider: auto` is set, Hermes scans your environment for active API keys (e.g., `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY`) and routes to cloud APIs. To force your local endpoint (e.g., Ollama or LocalAI), set `provider: custom` in `~/.hermes/config.yaml`:
```yaml
model:
  default: ollama/your-model
  provider: custom
  base_url: http://localhost:11434
```

**Q: Why are small local models (4B/9B) very slow?**
Hermes provides around 45 tool definitions in its schema, creating heavy prompt overhead. To optimize:
- Disable unused toolsets: `hermes tools`
- Set `terminal.backend: local` to avoid container overhead.
- Use faster quantization or larger models (32B+) for complex workflows.

**Q: How do I configure Google Gemini, Azure Foundry, or Ollama Cloud?**
- **Gemini:** Legacy CLI OAuth is deprecated. Use Google AI Studio with `GOOGLE_API_KEY` or `GEMINI_API_KEY`.
- **Azure AI Foundry:** Run `hermes setup` (auto-detects `ANTHROPIC_FOUNDRY_BASE_URL`) or set `provider: azure-foundry`.
- **Ollama Cloud:** Connects via OpenAI-compatible endpoints at `https://ollama.com/v1`.
- **Custom Vision Models:** Enable native image payloads for local/custom vision models by specifying `supports_vision: true` in your model configuration.

**Q: Why was `smart_model_routing` removed? Can Hermes automatically switch models per turn?**
No. Project policy explicitly forbids complexity-based automatic routing or per-turn cost-tier switching. Primary sessions retain their assigned model. To use distinct models for subtasks, configure `delegation.provider` / `delegation.model` or manually switch models with `/model` or `hermes chat -m <model>`.

---

## 3. Autonomy, Memory & Personas

**Q: Why did my session stop with a tool-call limit? How do I run long tasks?**
Sessions default to `agent.max_turns: 90` (overridable via `hermes chat --max-turns <N>`). For long-running, autonomous execution across turn boundaries, use `/goal <description>` (the Ralph loop) and continue paused budgets with `/goal resume` or `/resume`.

**Q: How do agent memory and personas work?**
- **`SOUL.md`**: Defines the agent's core persona and identity.
- **`USER.md`**: Stores persistent user profile information (targeted via memory tools with `target="user"`).
- **`MEMORY.md`**: Stores general conversation memory and facts.

---

## 4. Messaging Platforms & Gateways

**Q: Telegram says "Unauthorized user" even after adding `allowed_chats`. How do I authorize users?**
`allowed_chats` is only a whitelist for group chats. To authorize a user in DMs:
- Set `allow_from: "YOUR_USER_ID"` under `telegram:` in `~/.hermes/config.yaml` (or `TELEGRAM_ALLOWED_USERS`).
- Or use pairing: DM your bot and run `hermes pairing approve telegram <CODE>` on the host.

**Q: How do I configure Discord or other platforms interactively?**
Run `hermes gateway setup` to launch the interactive wizard to set bot tokens, allowed users, and channels.

**Q: Can gateways send and receive files, images, or distinct personas?**
- **Attachments:** Discord, Telegram, Matrix, and Email gateways support inbound file reading (.txt, .py, etc.) and native outbound document/media delivery. MCP server images (`MEDIA:<path>`) are also forwarded to chats.
- **Per-Channel Personas:** Use `channel_prompts` in your config to assign distinct system prompts per channel ID on Discord, Telegram, Slack, and Mattermost.
- **Multi-Profile Gateway:** Use multi-profile configurations to multiplex different accounts/credentials across platforms in an isolated gateway process.

---

## 5. Extensibility & Observability

**Q: How do I add custom tools or memory providers?**
- **Custom Tools:** In-tree additions are reserved for core tools. Place standalone tool plugins in `~/.hermes/plugins/` and enable them via `hermes plugins enable <plugin-name>`.
- **Memory Providers:** In-tree memory additions are closed. Implement the `MemoryProvider` ABC in a standalone plugin in `~/.hermes/plugins/`.
- **Observability & Tracing:** Enable bundled Langfuse tracing with `hermes plugins enable observability/langfuse`.
- **Skill Usage:** Check loaded and executed skills with `hermes insights` or `/insights`.

---

## 6. Security & Vulnerability Reporting
Report security vulnerabilities privately via [GitHub Security Advisories](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/security/advisories/new) or email `security@nousresearch.com`.
